data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1110 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a loss of GBP 0.2m (2018: profit of GBP 6.8m) of which a loss of GBP 0.4m is attributable to the 2019 year of account and a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase to Syndicate 1110's gross and net technical provisions for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 inclusive.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 reported a net profit of GBP 0.2m attributable to the 2017 and prior years of account, indicating a net release of reserves. Additionally, the syndicate entered into a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) in 2019, which resulted in a GBP 60.1m increase to gross technical provisions for underwriting years 2016 to 2018, covering Directors & Officers, Financial Institutions and Professional Indemnity business.
raw_causal_phrases: a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account
entered into a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) reinsurance
increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure for re-estimation of existing reserves was available. The syndicate also accepted a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) of GBP 60.1m for 2016-2018 underwriting years, which increased gross technical provisions but is considered an acquisition of liabilities rather than a re-estimation of existing reserves.
